g_1.summary: Fast-paced 1v1 air hockey matches. First to 5 goals wins.
g_1.rules: Standard air hockey rules. Serve alternates after each goal. Puck must cross center line to count.

g_2.summary: Table football (foosball) tournament. Teams of 2 compete in knockout format.
g_2.rules: 5 goals to win. No spinning. Serve from center after each goal. Winner stays on.

g_3.summary: Indoor bowls competition. Precision rolling to get closest to the jack.
g_3.rules: Each player rolls 2 bowls per end. 6 ends per match. Closest bowl to jack scores 1 point.

g_4.summary: Ten pin bowling. Highest total score across multiple frames wins.
g_4.rules: Standard ten pin scoring. 2 games per session. Total pinfall determines ranking.

g_5.summary: Darts competition. 501 format with best average deciding the winner.
g_5.rules: 501 straight start, double out. 3 darts per turn. Average points per game determines yearly ranking.

g_6.summary: Card games tournament. Various games played across the year.
g_6.rules: Different card games each year. Points awarded based on finishing position. Average points determines ranking.
